conf.description: Proofpoint TAP SIEM API URL click events, syslog-kv (format=syslog fallback): hand-built RFC 5424 SD parser per recommendations.direct.cribl since the stock proofpoint_tap clicks pipelines expect JSON. Sets _time to the later of clickTime/threatTime and copies url.full before renaming, matching the JSON integration's behavior; blocked-vs-permitted disposition is left unset (see README).

conf.comment: Proofpoint TAP click events via SIEM API syslog form (RFC 5424, [tapclk@21139 ...] SD block). Field homes match the JSON api-pull dataset. The JSON integration's clicks_blocked/clicks_permitted event.action split is not reconstructed here - the discriminating field (endpoint/eventTypeString) is not in the work order's field catalog, so it is not guessed.

functions.description: why this pipeline exists and its one documented gap
isolate the tapclk@21139 structured-data blob from the RFC 5424 header
parse the SD-PARAM key="value" pairs into flat fields - this dataset has no indexed/array SD-PARAMs

derive fields from the ORIGINAL flat vendor names before renaming: duplicate the clicked URL into url.full (the JSON path writes only url.full; the web profile also needs url.original, added below), and set _time to the later of clickTime/threatTime exactly as the JSON path does

batch rename the flat, clean-identifier SD-PARAM fields to their ECS or proofpoint_tap.* custom homes, including the destination.ip/source.ip orientation the JSON integration uses (clicking user in destination.ip, sender in source.ip)
tag the ECS data-stream dataset component (no hyphen, per constraint 5)
